0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, on a three-game losing streak and 12th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (3-1, on a three-game winning streak and 4th in the East) in the sixth game of the Bulls' season. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are listed as day-to-day, while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 134-99 in Boston on October 26, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
